title: Chuy’s Boom-Boom Sauce

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: ¼ Tbsp spices (source says ¼ Tbsp each salt and pepper)
1¼ lb easy-melt jack and cheddar cheese

steps: Heat broth, water and spices in a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Purée roasted green chiles, tomatillos, cilantro, green onions, serranos and lime juice. Add to the broth mixture in a large pot and bring to a slow boil.
Lower the heat and slowly whisk in the cheese to prevent clumps and sticking. Remove from heat when melted and combined.
